matters

captions.text: Well, fiber is essential. It's plant roughage.
It's the part of the plant that doesn't get digested and kind of moves through you.
Your body needs fiber, not just for digestive regularity,
but that fiber is doing things.
As the fiber goes down your digestive tract, it takes some of those unabsorbed calories
and carries them out, so it helps you to lose weight.
When the fiber arrives in your large intestine,
it actually fosters the growth of a healthy microbiome.
Those are the good bacteria that love you back.
